unit_file:
[Unit]
Description=bge-m3-cr-tapes-v1 unified embedding service
[Service]
User=svc
WorkingDirectory=/data/app
Environment=BGE_DEVICE=cuda
Environment=BGE_BATCH_SIZE=64
ExecStart=/data/app/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn bge_service:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8800
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
history_note: ps history shows a manually-launched uvicorn (with BGE_MODEL_PATH set) had owned port 8800 since 4 days ago; it was killed during the restart. The unit shows Restart=always, RestartSec=5. /data/models/* is writable by user svc; /etc/systemd requires root.
